summary: First-finish smoke test on Snooker Parlour app. Backend auth, tables, memberships, inventory, settings, and full session lifecycle (open → pause/resume → snacks → attach player → preview → close → credit) all working. Reports endpoint returns aggregated data. Role gating enforced (cashier POST /api/tables => 403; /admin redirects). Frontend login, dashboard with 4 tables, open-table flow, timer, pause/resume, close modal, reports page all load and function. Cashier UI hides admin nav.
passed: POST /api/auth/login admin & cashier return JWT
Invalid credentials return 401
GET /api/auth/me works with bearer token
GET /api/tables returns seeded Table 1 (₹220) + Tables 2-4 (₹320)
GET /api/memberships returns Regular (10%) & Premium (20%)
GET /api/inventory returns Tea/Coffee/Chips/Juice with stock
GET /api/settings returns business name 'South Point Snooker Academy' with ₹ currency
Cashier POST /api/tables → 403 (role gating)
Full session lifecycle via API: open, pause, resume, add snacks (stock decremented 99→98), attach player with Premium membership, preview-bill, close with partial payment generating credit
GET /api/credit/pending returns players with balance and total_pending
GET /api/reports?preset=today returns num_sessions, revenue, credit generated/received, payment method breakdown, table usage
Frontend: admin login → dashboard redirect
Dashboard shows all 4 table cards with correct testids
Open Table modal opens, accepts name+mobile, creates running session with visible timer
Pause/Resume UI toggles correctly (pause-btn → resume-btn)
Session control buttons present (pause/snacks/switch/player/close) with data-testids
Close modal opens and shows final amount
Reports page loads
Cashier login: /admin redirects to / (role gating enforced)
Cashier nav: Admin tab hidden (only Dashboard/Players/Inventory/Memberships/Credit/Reports visible)

failed.issue: After clicking pay-fill-full + close-save-btn on Close modal, invoice modal did not appear in this run and session on Table 1 remained running in final screenshot; a single 400 console error observed. Backend close endpoint verified working via direct API test, so this is likely a timing/state issue in the UI test or a minor client-side validation edge case worth verifying manually.
failed.evidence: Playwright log missing 'Invoice modal appeared' assertion; screenshot shows Table 1 still RUNNING with 'UI Test Player' after cashier login; console: 'Failed to load resource: 400'

failed.issue: POST /api/sessions/{id}/switch expects body field 'new_table_id'; the review request docs mention 'switch-target-select' which is fine, but callers using 'target_table_id' get 422. Frontend SwitchTableModal should be verified to send 'new_table_id'.

action_items: Manual verify UI close→invoice flow: click Close & Bill on a running session, use 'Fill full' then Save; ensure InvoiceModal appears and session releases the table. Investigate the single 400 API call in browser network tab.
Confirm SwitchTableModal on frontend posts field 'new_table_id' (not 'target_table_id') so switch works from UI.
